description: Single-scan present-vs-absent request/response counts for each client-sent filter (brands/zone/storeid/network/city/state/country/device) over a period, from the region request log. One row (ungrouped).

total_requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

total_responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND r.r_pcnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting__SP_REPORTING_DB_REGION__.os_product_ads_request_report AS r WHERE r.mcid = '__SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
